lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How long did you watch TV?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: 'bout 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then what happens?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And what's he sayin' while you're watching TV? Are you discussing this situation now?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What's he say, what did he sayin'? (pause) As hard as this is, you gotta tell us what he's sayin'.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He told me that's how you do it and

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That feels, he asked me if it felt good.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then what did you talk about, what else did you talk about?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That how he was going to get rid of it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what did he tell you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he was going to burn her.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When you say get rid of it, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Get rid of her body.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he says what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he was going to burn her body after that happened.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was there anything else that you guys talk about?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (shakes head "no") No.
